finding.headline: "Bedtime Is a War Zone (Toddler + Newborn)"
finding.problem: "By 7pm I have a screaming toddler who won't sleep and a newborn who won't stop crying. My husband is snoring. I cry in the bathroom."
finding.person: Mum where toddler fights bedtime and newborn wakes every 2 hrs; partner "sleeps through" night feeds; she's awake 22 hrs.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (split-bedtime system) — or Module inside A1". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
